notes: The installed app's TypeScript language server ran as Electron-as-node and died: vtsls.js was spawned as process.execPath with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1, which only works while the runAsNode fuse is on (dev); the packaged build turns that fuse off on purpose (a leaked ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE must not break the app), so the child booted a second TempCode, the single-instance lock killed it, and lsp.status reported "language server crashed repeatedly" while dev was fine — the first run of the signed 1.0.199 bundle under scripts/verify caught it. spawnWeb now launches vtsls under the real node (or bun) that resolveAppBridgeLaunch already finds on the login PATH for the Codex app bridge, and in a packaged build (process.defaultApp unset) refuses with a plain message instead of falling back to Electron-as-node; jdtls was never affected (it is Java).
